verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an overlay checkout that handles every part of the checkout process with minimal frontend code, plus an embeddable inline checkout via Paddle.js. That meets the core goal of taking payments without building your own payment UI. However, the evidence never shows a standalone hosted checkout page that customers are redirected to, and nothing backs the conversion-optimization claim. missing for 10: documented redirect-style hosted checkout page/URL, evidence of conversion optimization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
